findings.title: Response timeout loses the cleanup race
findings.why_it_matters: A non-responsive MCP server can hit Jest's own timeout before sendRequest rejects. Because the end-to-end test has already spent time on startup and earlier requests, its remaining test budget is less than RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS; Jest may abort the test before control reaches the finally block that terminates the child, undermining the prompt-failure and no-orphan guarantees this change is intended to add.
findings.suggested_fix: Set an explicit per-test timeout comfortably above all helper deadlines and make RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS materially shorter than that budget. Add a synthetic server that starts successfully but never responds, then assert the request rejects within the response deadline and the child has exited after finally cleanup.
evidence: tests/e2e/server.test.ts:248-252 only rejects a hung request when that full 5000ms timer fires.

tests/e2e/server.test.ts:363 defines the end-to-end test without an explicit timeout, while the installed Jest circus state defaults testTimeout to 5000ms; startup and prior requests consume part of that same budget.
The lifecycle table at tests/e2e/server.test.ts:332-359 covers startup stderr, early exit, and startup timeout, but does not exercise response timeout plus child cleanup.

residual_risks: Failure-path storage isolation relies on MCP_BPMN_DIAGRAMS_PATH while inheriting the real HOME; a future fallback or dual-write regression could touch the user's default diagrams directory before cleanup, and the test does not assert that fallback root remains untouched.
testing_gaps: No synthetic post-startup response-timeout case proves that sendRequest rejects promptly and the enclosing cleanup terminates the child.
The prior invalid-tool case was removed, so the expected JSON-RPC success envelope carrying an MCP tool-level isError result is no longer asserted.
Schema fingerprints intentionally omit every description field, so misleading tool/property description regressions pass as long as descriptions remain non-empty.
